text:
jun: seeing a sharp queue spike on the hotpath in us-west-2 — p99s and 503s up around 09:12PT. warm pool dropped to 0 while launches were still pending.
elaine: ugh. is this the single-customer burst or multi-tenant?
jun: looks like a single large tenant + a few background batch jobs. queue depth peaked ~420, avg wait ~320ms. warm_pool_free=0, launching=12 but kube scheduling lagged.
khalid: can you paste the admission/token-bucket numbers?
jun: admission tokens drained immediately. snapshot: ```queue_depth: 420
avg_wait_ms: 320
warm_pool_ready: 0
instances_launching: 12
instance_termination_events: 3 (spot churn)```
elaine: two quick things: 1) we should add jittered prewarm launches so they don't all land at once; 2) soft-admit for the premium routes so hedged probes can bypass hard rejection.
khalid: +1. proposal: bump hotpath warm_headroom +25%, enable prewarm_jitter 20-40s, and set admission.soft_admit=true for tier=premium. also reduce token-bucket refill to target_util 0.65 so we have more headroom on bursts.
sam: what's the monthly cost delta if we keep +25% headroom in us-west?
elaine: rough back-of-envelope: ~10 extra GPUs average across peak windows -> ~6k/mo. tradeoff is p95/p99 drops massively and fewer customer incidents.
jun: config snippet I'm thinking we can canary: ```autoscaler: 
  min_warm: 8
  warm_headroom_pct: 25
  prewarm_jitter_seconds: 30
  target_utilization: 0.65
admission: 
  soft_admit: true
  token_bucket_rate: 800
  burst_holdback: 0.2```
khalid: also add an autoscale holdback: when new instance launches exceed N within T seconds, slow further launches by 10s to avoid saturating our control plane. jitter+holdback avoids launch thundering.
jun: agree. we should also gate the change behind a small canary in us-west-2 (10% of hotpath traffic) and watch queue depth, launch latencies, and pod readiness.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-4213: "canary: warm-headroom +25% + soft-admit for hotpath (us-west-2)" assigned to eng-infra.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started -> us-west-2 subset (10%) warm_headroom=25% prewarm_jitter=30s soft_admit=true :rocket:
sam: monitor cost dashboard and alert if sustained GPU-hours > +15% for 24h.
elaine: if canary looks good after 2h, we roll to 50% then 100% with 20m pauses. if spot churn is culprit, we should move critical pools to reserved instances for hotpath.
jun: will add dashboards (queue_depth, warm_pool_free, pod_ready_delta, avg_launch_time) and a runbook snippet.
khalid: one more note: add a metric for "launch_thundering_score" (variance of pod ready times) + an alert when > threshold. helps catch regressions.
sam: :thumbsup: thanks all. let's keep cost/latency tradeoffs explicit in ticket.
elaine: +1. if canary reduces p99 by >60% we accept cost delta. eyes on dashboards for next 3 hours :eyes:
